name: NaviClean
description: NaviClean scans and cleans mounted Navidrome music libraries with guided organization previews, duplicate review, unindexed and non-music cleanup, Spotify-backed discovery, and audio conversion.

paths.name: Config Folder
paths.description: Stores NaviClean settings, auth configuration, and the latest scan catalog

paths.name: Navidrome Music Library
paths.description: Host music folder that Navidrome scans. NaviClean needs read/write access to organize, convert, trash cleanup candidates, and place removed files in /music/.naviclean-trash by default.

ports.name: Web Port
ports.description: Container 8080 - Host port for the NaviClean web UI

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: Unraid user ID used by NaviClean for /data and /music access. Keep 99 for the default nobody user.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Unraid group ID used by NaviClean for /data and /music access. Keep 100 for the default users group.

variables.name: Trust Proxy
variables.description: Express trust-proxy setting. Keep 1 when NaviClean is behind Unraid, Nginx Proxy Manager, SWAG, authentik, or another reverse proxy.

variables.name: Secure Cookies
variables.description: Cookie secure mode: auto follows HTTPS/proxy headers, true always requires HTTPS, and false allows direct HTTP/LAN testing.

variables.name: Cookie SameSite
variables.description: Session cookie SameSite mode. Use lax for normal installs, none for cross-site reverse-proxy flows that require it, or strict for tighter same-site access.

variables.name: Advanced Diagnostics
variables.description: Set to 1 to show the internal Diagnostics page and matching-inspection API routes.
